scope: Complete remote saved-file decoding plus independently inspected native getter/setter ownership; diagnostic observations only, no active-camera formula or writer acceptance

remote.projection: Typed view fields and graph proofs retained; complete per-stream report objects represented by canonical SHA-256 alongside byte comparisons; all source fingerprints retained

limitations: All native observations used hidden sessions without an explicit camera intervention
Identity observations do not establish active viewport state or the role of the second document transform
Captured environment/window values are research observations and are prohibited as writer templates
The native default setter operation forwards to the transform assignment operator; higher active-camera callers are untraced
